# LaunchPad

> Nextcloud app for multiple drag-and-drop dashboards with widgets, shortcut tiles, conditional visibility rules and admin templates for groups.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): features, screenshots and installation overview
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): build, test and lint commands and repo conventions for coding agents
- [Development](DEVELOPMENT.md): local development environment and adding a widget type
- [Development workflow](docs/development.md): branches, quality checks and setup
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): pull requests and commit message format
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): manifest, OpenRegister consumption policy and permission model
- [Introduction](docs/intro.md): user-facing documentation entry point
- [Features](docs/features/README.md): per-feature documentation
- [OpenRegister-backed widgets](docs/widgets/or-data.md): pattern for widgets that read OpenRegister data
- [Embedding](docs/embed/overview.md): embedding dashboards and widgets in other sites
- [Architecture decisions](docs/adr/README.md): pointer to the company-wide ADRs
- [App decision records](openspec/architecture/adr-001-information-architecture.md): app-level information architecture decision

## API

- [OpenAPI document](openapi.json): the JSON API under /api/v1/
- [REST API guide](docs/features/rest-api.md): how to use the REST API
- [Routes](appinfo/routes.php): every route the app registers
- [App manifest](src/manifest.json): menu entries and pages

## Specs

- [OpenSpec config](openspec/config.yaml): project context and rules for changes
- [Dashboards](openspec/specs/dashboards/spec.md): dashboard lifecycle
- [Widgets](openspec/specs/widgets/spec.md): widget placement and types
- [Tiles](openspec/specs/tiles/spec.md): custom shortcut tiles
- [Grid layout](openspec/specs/grid-layout/spec.md): grid behaviour
- [Permissions](openspec/specs/permissions/spec.md): permission levels
- [Dashboard sharing](openspec/specs/dashboard-sharing/spec.md): sharing with users and groups
- [Admin templates](openspec/specs/admin-templates/spec.md): templates distributed to groups
- [Conditional visibility](openspec/specs/conditional-visibility/spec.md): visibility rules
- [Admin settings](openspec/specs/admin-settings/spec.md): global settings
- [API contract](openspec/specs/api-contract/spec.md): API conventions
- [Runtime OpenRegister consumption](openspec/specs/runtime-or-consumption/spec.md): optional OpenRegister use
- [All capability specs](openspec/specs/): one folder per capability
